title: Hope for the Broken
definition: Hope for the broken means that God's grace in Christ reaches people wounded by sin, suffering, addiction, shame, grief, weakness, and failure.
summary: No one is too broken for the mercy of God. Christ receives, restores, strengthens, and uses people who know their need.
christFocus: Jesus is near to the brokenhearted and gives rest to the weary.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: No one is too broken for the mercy of God. Christ receives, restores, strengthens, and uses people who know their need.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
